dispositions.COPY: Reusable engine/runtime/mechanics/schema/validator/migration/control surface/selected reusable proof. Copied byte-for-byte from the exact Git blob with the Git file mode preserved. Never applied to a directory as a single unit.
dispositions.EXCLUDE: RHC campaign instance material, story/history, canaries, engineering history, or factory-only POST-EV2-Z machinery. Absent from the exported customer tree (folder skeleton excepted).
dispositions.GENERATE_EMPTY: Declared mutable campaign root required for genesis, emitted as contract-valid EMPTY / UNKNOWN state from the fixed generation constants in this policy, materialized at the rule's declared output_path when one is present (otherwise at the source path). The disposition also carries the one explicit, proven portability adaptation: the shipped RT01 runtime workflow is generated from a fixed policy constant equal to the source workflow minus its source-only pytest arguments, so the exported product's CI commands reference only shipped executable surfaces.

match_semantics: Each rule 'match' is either an exact repository-relative path or an EXCLUDE-only directory prefix ending in '/'. A path resolves to the rule with the longest matching string. No match => FAIL (unclassified). More than one rule tied at the winning length => FAIL (ambiguous). COPY is never a directory prefix (Classification Granularity Rule).

state/daily_recap.json.system: Rolling High Club Daily Recap Live State
state/daily_recap.json.purpose: Player-known in-day recap and next-scene handoff for the current active campaign day. Permanent finalized history belongs in canon/days/.

state/day_resolution.json.purpose: Current-day RNG and mechanical resolutions that must survive a handoff. This file is optional/inert until a tracked mechanic is actually used.

state/dm_meta.json.purpose: Committed hidden runtime truth and durable DM-only handoff that already matters to continuity but is not player-known. Uncommitted future ideas belong in planned/ or brainstorm/ instead.

state/live_status.json.purpose: Generic mutable campaign resources, assets, persistent effects and obligations when repository tracking is useful.

knowledge/facts.json.purpose: Stable reusable world facts with explicit META/NON_META visibility. Character-specific knowledge remains local to NPC/character state.

quests/narrative_hooks.json.system: Rolling High Club Narrative Hook Ledger
quests/narrative_hooks.json.purpose: Single current owner of active, dormant and current-day closed multi-day narrative Hooks.

# Campaign

A campaign-neutral canvas exported from a reusable tabletop engine.

This canvas is a clean starting point: it carries no campaign history, entities, characters, canon or mutable state from any source campaign. Unestablished values remain unknown until they are established in play.

## Start Here

1. Read [`PROJECT_PRIMER.md`](PROJECT_PRIMER.md) for the workspace governance and continuity rules.
2. Read [`docs/DM_CONTROL_ROOM.md`](docs/DM_CONTROL_ROOM.md) to classify a request and choose the smallest source.
3. Read [`docs/RHC_WORKSYSTEM.md`](docs/RHC_WORKSYSTEM.md) before a save, handoff or day rollover.
4. Read [`AGENT_HANDOFF.md`](AGENT_HANDOFF.md) to route agent work.

## Core Principle

The repository stores the knowledge. The Dungeon Master creates the story.

jobs:
  # Shard 1 of 4 — RT01 floor, campaign clock and the runtime mirror.
  prove-runtime-floor:
    name: RT01 runtime foundation (runtime floor)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: rhc
          POSTGRES_DB: rhc
        ports:
          - 55432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d rhc"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      postgres17:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: rhc
          POSTGRES_DB: rhc
        ports:
          - 55433:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d rhc"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Prove RT01/RT02 floor + runtime mirror on PostgreSQL 15/17 + real Git objects
        run: >-
          pytest
          tests/rt01a
          tests/rt01b
          tests/rt01c
          tests/rt01d
          tests/rt01activation
          tests/rt02
          tests/test_runtime_published_mirror.py
          -v
      - name: Prove HWB-02 SAVE runtime authority on PostgreSQL 15/17 (separate process)
        run: pytest tests/hwb02 -v

  # Shard 2 of 4 — canonical Run read/reconciliation and the EV2-10 spine link.

  # Shard 4 of 4 — POST-EV2 runtime frontier (impact/temporal/search/vitals/rest/reputation).
  prove-post-ev2-frontier:
    name: RT01 runtime foundation (post-EV2 frontier)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: rhc
          POSTGRES_DB: rhc
        ports:
          - 55432:5432
        options: >-

        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: rhc
          POSTGRES_DB: rhc
        ports:
          - 55433:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d rhc"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Prove POST-EV2-3/4A/5/9/10/11/11.9 on PostgreSQL 15/17 + real Git objects
        run: >-
          pytest
          tests/post_ev2_3
          tests/post_ev2_4a
          tests/post_ev2_5
          tests/post_ev2_11
          tests/post_ev2_11_9
          tests/post_ev2_12
          -v

  # Stable aggregate RT01 signal. Branch protection / merge gating consumes this
  # one check name; it succeeds only when every required proof shard succeeds and
  # fails whenever any shard fails, is cancelled or is otherwise not green.
  prove-runtime-foundation:
    name: prove-runtime-foundation
    needs:
      - prove-runtime-floor
      - prove-run-spine
      - prove-entity-timeline
      - prove-post-ev2-frontier
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require every RT01 proof shard to succeed
        shell: bash
        env:
          RUNTIME_FLOOR: ${{ needs.prove-runtime-floor.result }}
          RUN_SPINE: ${{ needs.prove-run-spine.result }}
          ENTITY_TIMELINE: ${{ needs.prove-entity-timeline.result }}
          POST_EV2_FRONTIER: ${{ needs.prove-post-ev2-frontier.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "RT01 shard results:"
          echo "  runtime floor   : $RUNTIME_FLOOR"
          echo "  run spine       : $RUN_SPINE"
          echo "  entity+timeline : $ENTITY_TIMELINE"
          echo "  post-EV2 front  : $POST_EV2_FRONTIER"
          for result in \
            "$RUNTIME_FLOOR" \
            "$RUN_SPINE" \
            "$ENTITY_TIMELINE" \
            "$POST_EV2_FRONTIER"; do
            if [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
              echo "One or more required RT01 proof shards did not succeed." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done
